job_description:
JOB TITLE: Technical Product Manager (AI & Data)
LOCATION: New York, NY
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: 4+ years

JOB DESCRIPTION:
We are hiring a Technical Product Manager to drive product strategy for our generative AI features. You will bridge business stakeholders and ML engineering teams, define technical product roadmaps, and track product analytics.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- 4+ years of technical product management experience.
- Strong technical fluency in AI/ML concepts, RAG, and LLM capabilities.
- Proficiency in SQL and user analytics.
- Demonstrated ability to manage Agile software development teams (Jira, Scrum).

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS:
- Computer Science or Engineering background.
- Experience evaluating LLM output quality and user experience metrics.
